status: PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE EXECUTION. Immutable and additive. It CLARIFIES the amendment; it does not alter it. The amended file is left byte-identical.
reason: Two conceptual corrections raised by the architect before execution. Nothing had been executed when this addendum was written: no fold, no fit, no receipt.

correction_1_baseline_qualification.supersedes_phrase: the amendment's experiment_matrix arm A field 'everything_else': 'identical to B1R1'
correction_1_baseline_qualification.why_it_was_wrong: Unqualified, that phrase would imply the validation design is also identical to B1R1. It is not. B1R1 used 6 leave-one-complete-cycle-out folds holding out 910 rows. B1R2-A uses the CORRECTED Rev1 design: 11 folds, 8 structurally complete cycles plus 3 tails, holding out all 1313 non-WAIT rows exactly once.
correction_1_baseline_qualification.correct_statement: The single experimental variable is the OPTIMISATION BUDGET measured against the CORRECTED Rev1 baseline (11 folds / 1313 rows), not against B1R1 (6 folds / 910 rows).
what_is_inherited_from_B1R1_unchanged: fit procedure: v26b_b_exec.fit_masked, reused with unchanged semantics
optimizer Adam, batch 64, lr 3e-4, seed 123, per-epoch shuffle
loss: flat MSE + clip-loss 1.0 + logstd 0.1 + anchor 1e-5
dataset, labels, caches, the three pinned V26 anchors, 1500 rows
student: 35D, hard input mask on columns 0:2 and 25:35, effective 23D, frozen logstd, untouched critic
all gate thresholds, imported from v26b_b1r1_exec and not relaxed

what_changed_and_why.validation_design: 6 folds / 910 heldout rows -> 11 folds / 1313 heldout rows
what_changed_and_why.classification: METHODOLOGICAL PREREQUISITE, not a second experimental arm
what_changed_and_why.justification: The B1R2 rev1 study established that the 6-fold design left 403 rows never held out, and that the error is concentrated in two of those segments which are structurally complete cycles. Selecting an epoch on a curve blind to 403 of 1313 rows would be unsound regardless of budget. The corrected design is the precondition for the budget question to be answerable at all, not a competing treatment.
what_changed_and_why.matrix_impact: none. The experiment matrix still has exactly ONE binding row, arm A.

correction_1_baseline_qualification.how_the_budget_contrast_stays_clean: Because arm A records every fold's full 1200-epoch curve with no internal early stop, the July rule is applied twice to the SAME curves: truncated at 400 and over the full 1200. The 400-truncation IS the corrected-design 400-epoch reference. The budget contrast is therefore internal to arm A, on identical fits and an identical 11-fold design, with no confound from the design correction. e_star_400 remains DIAGNOSTIC ONLY and can never change e*, the gates or the verdict.
correction_1_baseline_qualification.honest_limitation: A direct B1R1-vs-B1R2A contrast is NOT available and must not be claimed: the two differ in both design and budget. Only the internal 400-vs-1200 contrast is a valid budget measurement.

correction_2_clip_is_not_gradient_clippi.why_it_matters: The amendment lists the loss as 'flat MSE + clip 1.0 + logstd 0.1 + anchor 1e-5'. Read carelessly, 'clip 1.0' could be mistaken for gradient clipping. It is not, and the receipt and report must not permit that reading.

what_clip_1_0_actually_is.kind: loss term weight, an action-bound penalty
what_clip_1_0_actually_is.purpose: penalises predicted actions outside the normalised bound [-1, +1]; it acts on the network OUTPUT, inside the objective

gradient_clipping.note: no gradient-norm or gradient-value clipping is applied anywhere. The only gradient manipulation in fit_masked is the first-layer column mask W1.grad.mul_(col_mask), which zeroes the masked and clock columns and is a masking operation, not clipping.
gradient_clipping.enforced_by: the test asserts that no clip_grad call exists in the executor or in fit_masked

correction_2_clip_is_not_gradient_clippi.receipt_and_report_requirement: both must carry these two fields explicitly and separately: 'clip_loss_weight_J_CLIP_W' and 'gradient_clipping': 'none'.

unchanged_by_this_addendum: the hypothesis and its single variable
the epoch selection rule and its no-future-reading property
the stop/go policy, including NO-GO stopping offline with no candidate promoted
the prohibition on rollout, collection, DAgger, PPO, gradient clipping and any autonomous arm B
